new_discriminators: TransformAttributeOld16884-16894 deliberately drops logicalOld when its prefix has no proof variables. Physical capture/cleanup must not use that shortcut: Capture("x")Old can still allocate. Logical state-independence is not allocation-freedom.

Normal exp_attr5724 creates a distinct physical Old temporary marked StoresAttributeOldPrefix, including conditional/indirect forms. Repeated equal prefixes may share a logical term but cannot have physical owner counts merged unless actual compiler coalescing is established.

Current FinalizationActions has a real finally-section translation arm and otherwise borrow restoration/leak checks; new cleanup should be lowered through these existing constructs, not a new trusted cleanup axiom.

Current assignment inserts deep moves before leak checking; strict nonlimited copy must not move its source. Deep-copy semantics require a different branch before this operation, plus hook-body permission proof.

Direct application calls to a designated Adjust procedure are ordinary calls. They cannot be granted compiler-copy privilege merely by procedure name or type aspect; otherwise existing live ownership could be overwritten/leaked with a green report.

Adjustment/allocation failure can leave a mixture of source views and newly owned parts. Never call a generic finalizer over a source alias merely to clear a leak VC. Exact compiler enrollment/exception scheduling and hook-owned partial cleanup are required.

Fresh function-result capture can avoid an extra Adjust/Finalize pair through compiler BIR/elision. It is a useful first cleanup slice, but does not qualify ordinary B:=A, overwrite or independent-value semantics.

hook_implementation_shape.single_string: For a copy-origin hook, conceptually observe incoming Data, detach Object.Data to null WITHOUT freeing that view, then clone the full original String including exact bounds into fresh owned storage. This is not permitted for an arbitrary ordinary live-owner call. The existing D47 naive overwrite cannot be treated as ordinary ownership transfer.
hook_implementation_shape.sequence: Keep an immutable source observer outside the owned destination prefix. Detach destination view before building. Iteratively append freshly owned complete nodes. If any allocation fails, reclaim only the already built destination prefix and propagate original failure. No recursion, cap, global registry or custom pool is proposed.
hook_implementation_shape.exceptions: Do not assume failed Adjust is registered or finalized the same way as a completed object. Read actual compiler AST/expanded output when later authorized; model normal/failed initialization explicitly. Prove finalizer itself cannot raise on the supported product representation, or model actual strict exception sequencing without suppressing it.
hook_implementation_shape.not_a_new_public_precondition: Copy-origin is a verifier-only compiler event, not a new caller obligation to manage snapshot death or a narrower accepted input domain.
